gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-piazzolla: Piazzolla reads with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals and an e that gapes open. Eight Bit Dragon strides wide and bold with soft stem swells, while Piazzolla, a text serif, does its best work in steady, authoritative lines.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-pridi: Tall, swaggering and a bit adventurous, Eight Bit Dragon spreads its letters out wide. Pridi, a text serif with small letters standing almost capital-sized, brings the refined counterweight that makes this pairing memorable.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-scope-one: Eight Bit Dragon walks widely spaced letters across the line, with a towering lowercase and mild stroke variation. Scope One answers with stubby ascenders, a big x-height and counters that spill into the space around them.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-gf-suwannaph: Suwannaphum has a c as open as a bent paperclip. Eight Bit Dragon is best at bold, loose-limbed display lettering with tempered stroke contrast, while this serif is best at dignified, high-standing text with an editorial feel.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-mulish: Eight Bit Dragon strides across widely separated letters, its strokes tapering like wire rolled barely flat. Mulish, a sans-serif with no stroke modulation, is the modern, approachable half.
gen-dafont-eight-bit-dragon-rubik: Rubik brings soft, clean lowercase that looks big beside its capitals, with round shapes that stay legible when small. And Eight Bit Dragon adds adventurous, widely spaced letters with only mild thicks, so the two feel friendly together.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-epunda-sla: Striking, gap-toothed and commanding, Electroharmonix breaks every word into separate letters. Epunda Slab, a text serif with a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase, gives that spacing a dignified, classic anchor.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-fauna-one: Electroharmonix splits words into single letters, with open-handed curves in every round shape. And Fauna One, with its tall middle band and shallow ascenders, adds a literary, dignified feel that sits quietly beside it.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-glegoo: Electroharmonix breaks each word into single, open-gapped letters. Glegoo, a text serif with big counters and wide, unclosed curves, carries the refined editorial voice beneath it.
gen-dafont-electroharmonix-gf-kadwa: Classic in mood, Kadwa brings open-ended curves and a larger-than-usual x-height to the text. But Electroharmonix earns its keep big and short, where its gapped, open-handed letters can look striking and commanding.
